subject: Request: temporary invoice timing adjustment (quarterly / Net-90 pilot)
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@acquistix.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: temporary invoice timing adjustment (quarterly / Net-90 pilot)

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week — the platform looks like a great fit for our observability use cases. Procurement asked me to confirm whether Redwood can accommodate a short-term billing cadence change while we onboard (they need invoices aligned to our fiscal milestones). Specifically: can we run a 3-month pilot on quarterly invoicing with Net-90 payment terms? The pilot scope would be $60k over three months (billed once at the end of the quarter).

If needed, we can provide a PO in advance and an ACH mandate, but our AP team prefers consolidated invoices and a single payment window aligned to their quarter close. This is a pilot ask only — long-term terms will revert to standard monthly invoices.

Attached is the procurement contact and a draft PO for reference. Can you let me know what approvals you’ll need? Happy to jump on a short call this week.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of IT Procurement | Acquistix
Mobile: +1-415-555-0198

Attachments: Acquistix_PO_20270815.pdf

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@acquistix.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary invoice timing adjustment (quarterly / Net-90 pilot)

Elena — appreciate the clear ask and the PO. Looping in Jordan (account exec) and Marissa (sales ops) to start internal approvals.

Short answer: we can consider a limited, conditional Net-90 / quarterly pilot, but we need an executive exception and a few guardrails:
- Pilot capped at $60k and timeboxed to one quarter
- PO up front and ACH/credit authorization on file (to mitigate collection risk)
- No changes to SLA or support SLAs without explicit write-up
- Option to switch back to monthly billing after pilot automatically

Marissa / Jordan — can you advise on the approval path and whether we should require a small prepayment or adjusted discount as compensation for extended remit?

Elena — I’ll update you once I have sign-off. If it helps we can target a short exec call on Friday to finalize conditions.

Thanks,
Logan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary invoice timing adjustment (quarterly / Net-90 pilot)

Logan / Jordan — reviewing with Rev Ops and Legal. High-level recommendation for a one-quarter pilot:
1) Approve Net-90 / quarterly billing for a single quarter only (retroactive reversion to standard monthly billing).
2) Require PO + ACH mandate OR 25% prepayment to be invoiced immediately on PO receipt. Prepayment reduces cash exposure and gives us leverage if AP falls behind.
3) Apply a 3% platform fee (one-time) OR remove any promotional discount for that quarter — we should not combine both a discount and extended payment without greater credit protection.
4) Add an amendment (1-page) to the MSA documenting the pilot window, invoicing cadence, and collection triggers. I attached the amendment draft.

If Jonas (ops exec) signs off, we can send the amendment to Acquistix and finalize. Also recommend credit team run a quick credit check (Jordan, can you trigger?).

Marissa
Senior Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_net90_amendment_draft.docx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary invoice timing adjustment (quarterly / Net-90 pilot)

Approved with conditions (RDW-2319):
- Approve Net-90 / quarterly invoicing for a single, timeboxed pilot (next fiscal quarter only).
- Require PO plus ACH mandate OR 25% prepayment prior to provisioning.
- No discount stacking; remove any promotional credits for pilot period OR include a 3% one-time platform fee at signing.
- Sales to ensure amendment (1-pager) is signed and attached to the account record before billing cycle begins.
- Credit to be run and transaction to be flagged for collections monitoring.

Logan — please send the amendment to Elena and capture signed PO/ACH. Jordan — run credit and place a 30-day collections watch. Marissa — update HubSpot and attach amendment/PO.

Jonas Weber
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
